cohort: This is a review paper and does not involve a specific cohort of participants from a primary study conducted by the authors.
finding: Bacteriotherapy, including approaches like Fecal Microbiota Transplantation (FMT) and psychobiotics, is presented as a promising and effective therapeutic strategy for managing a range of conditions from infectious diseases and cancer to metabolic and neuropsychiatric disorders by correcting disturbed intestinal microbiota.
mod_finding: A higher rate of cesarean section is identified as a major contributing factor to gut dysbiosis.
followup_time: N/A (as this is a review; one referenced study mentioned 1-13 years post-FMT)
